resources.string: Sebenzisa i-keybox edalwe. Ukungenisa i-keybox kuyayivala lokhu.
Cela i-keybox ku-Google usebenzisa isevisi yokuhlinzeka yale divayisi. Idinga i-firmware ye-Qualcomm ehambisanayo.
Phatha i-RKP yedivayisi kusuka kuphrofayela yomnikazi wedivayisi
Icimile. Vula i-RKP yedivayisi ukuze usebenzise noma udale i-keybox.
I-keybox edalwe isebenza. Izivuselela yodwa ngaphambi kuka-%1$s
I-keybox edalwe iphelelwe yisikhathi. Dala enye esikhundleni sayo.
I-firmware iphikisile isicelo (ikhodi %1$d). I-Duck V1 ingase ingasekelwa.
Ayikwazanga ukufinyelela iseva yokuhlinzeka. Hlola uxhumo lwakho.
Impendulo yeseva ilahlekile. Isicelo mhlawumbe sesicutshungulwe; akukho ukuzama kabusha okwenziwe ngokuzenzakalelayo.
Izitifiketi ze-keybox zehlulekile ukuqinisekiswa. I-keybox ekhona igciniwe.
Isikhathi sokuhlinzeka siphelile. Uma isevisi yedivayisi isathiyelwe, qala kabusha idivayisi ngaphambi kokuzama futhi.
Isicelo sikhanseliwe ngoba ukumiswa kwe-keybox kushintshile
